title: Bob Baker MITRE paper on Ning Li's AC/DC gravity

tellings.quote: aspect. However, there is a paper that was released by Bob Baker under the MITRE Corporation for one of the high-frequency gravitational wave conferences where

plain: A researcher, Dave Rossi, told podcast host Jesse Michels about a paper from the 2000s by a man named Bob Baker, written under MITRE, a research organisation that works for the US government, for a conference on high-frequency gravitational waves. Rossi says that the paper deals with the work of a physicist, Ning Li, on what is called AC/DC gravity, the idea of producing gravity-like effects with electricity. He raises it because, if true, it would show serious research into controlling gravity.
